title: “We were looking at it wrong”: The explosive claim that’s upended the AI world
summary: “I think I have good news about the nature of neural networks.” With those simple words of optimism, Nick Cammarata, a researcher at the AI startup Goodfire, kicked off a 26,000-word blog post that has knocked the AI world on its head, sparking wild speculation as well as cautious (and not-so-cautious) celebration. Cammarata’s claim is…
title_es: Investigador de Goodfire cuestiona fundamentos de redes neuronales
bajada: Un investigador del startup Goodfire publicó un análisis de 26,000 palabras que desafía la comprensión actual sobre cómo funcionan las redes neuronales, generando debate intenso en la comunidad de IA. El hallazgo potencialmente abre nuevas direcciones para el desarrollo de modelos más eficientes.
bajada_en: A Goodfire researcher published a 26,000-word analysis challenging current understanding of how neural networks function, sparking intense debate in the AI community. The finding potentially opens new directions for developing more efficient models.

title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
summary: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.
title_es: Nvidia lanza modelos abiertos para agentes empresariales
bajada: Nvidia presenta nuevos modelos open-source optimizados para ejecutar agentes de IA en centros de datos empresariales y dispositivos locales. La iniciativa responde a la demanda creciente de soluciones de IA privada y soberana en las organizaciones.
bajada_en: Nvidia releases new open-source models optimized for running AI agents in enterprise data centers and on-device. The initiative addresses growing demand for private and sovereign AI solutions across organizations.

title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
summary: A hacker broke into more than 100 websites using an army of AI agents that mostly operated on their own, according to findings from the AI security firm Norforge. Though Norforge doesn't name the targets, Reuters reports that the victims included companies like John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins. Concerns over AI-powered cybersecurity breaches have grown […]
title_es: Hacker usó ejército de agentes IA para infiltrarse en 100 sitios
bajada: Según Norforge, un atacante utilizó agentes de IA autónomos para comprometer más de 100 sitios web, incluyendo John Deere, SharkNinja y Cummins. El incidente subraya nuevos riesgos de seguridad cibernética derivados de sistemas agenticos.
bajada_en: According to Norforge, an attacker used autonomous AI agents to compromise over 100 websites, including John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins. The incident highlights emerging cybersecurity risks from agentic systems.

title: Oct 18, 2026AnnouncementsInvesting in the public benefit
summary: Announcements Investing in the public benefit Oct 18, 2026 Today, we’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows. Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic’s shares will be committed today, with an additional 2% added at the board’s discretion for every 50% increase in the company’s value above a set baseline. As a public benefit corporation, most of our work in pursuit of our mission takes place inside the company: research relevant to AI safety and interpretability; applied biomedical research; discounts on Claude for nonprofits and scientific institutions. These activities have both a public benefit component and for-profit value, so we house them directly in the company. The Anthropic Public Benefit Fund will have increased flexibility and scale, enabling us to pursue our mission in new ways: for example, we might explore large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations. One example is labor market impacts. AI may generate enormous economic value, but it could also cause instability for many workers. Anthropic has already committed $200 million to studying and addressing this issue, but given the pace of AI progress, bolder approaches may be needed. The Fund will have the versatility to pursue them. We’re establishing the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund as a wholly-owned LLC—rather than a 501(c)(3) or other format—to give adjustability between different forms of giving. None of the Anthropic equity held by the LLC will be used for lobbying or political giving, in the US or abroad. Because of the way the Fund is structured, the more Anthropic grows, the larger the share of the company that can be dedicated expressly to the public good. title_es: Anthropic crea fondo de beneficio público con acciones
bajada: Anthropic comprometió el 5% de sus acciones a un Fondo de Beneficio Público, con potencial de aumentar al 7% conforme la compañía crece. La estructura busca financiar investigación en seguridad de IA, bioética y apoyo a poblaciones afectadas por automatización.
bajada_en: Anthropic committed 5% of its shares to a Public Benefit Fund, with potential to increase to 7% as the company grows. The structure aims to fund AI safety research, bioethics, and support for populations affected by automation.

title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
title_es: Agentes híbridos razonan en espacio latente y actúan por texto
bajada: Investigadores de Together Computer presentan Hybrid Reasoning Agents, un enfoque que combina razonamiento en espacio latente con actuación textual. La arquitectura promete mayor eficiencia en agentes complejos con código disponible en GitHub.
bajada_en: Together Computer researchers present Hybrid Reasoning Agents, combining latent space reasoning with text-based action. The architecture promises greater efficiency for complex agents with code available on GitHub.

title: Maxwell: a new model that speeds up AI models like Whisper and LTX-2 by rewriting their binaries [D]
summary: Came across this today and haven't seen it discussed here yet. It's apparently a new type of model (called Maxwell) that sits under a running program and speeds it up on the fly based on what it sees (hardware and data). The cool thing is that it doesn't change the source code, but instead it modifies the binaries (during runtime!). So kind of like a JIT, except it's a model working out what to change instead of a fixed set of compiler heuristics.What got me is that they seem to be using formal verification to prove the optimized version still does the same thing, which I guess is the only way you could let something like this loose with no one checking it. No idea how that holds up with floating point or anything nondeterministic, to be honestsubmitted by/u/EvilHackFar[link][comments]
title_es: Maxwell optimiza binarios de modelos IA en tiempo real
bajada: Maxwell es un nuevo modelo que acelera aplicaciones de IA como Whisper y LTX-2 reescribiendo binarios dinámicamente, sin modificar código fuente. Utiliza verificación formal para garantizar que las optimizaciones preserven el comportamiento original.
bajada_en: Maxwell is a new model that accelerates AI applications like Whisper and LTX-2 by dynamically rewriting binaries without source code changes. It uses formal verification to ensure optimizations preserve original behavior.

title: Disney Asked Character.AI to Go Bankrupt for a Get-Out-of-Lawsuits Card
summary: The entertainment giant hopes to get trust and safety tech, among other IP, from a startup whose chatbots dozens of states allege encouraged minors to self-harm and kill their parents.
title_es: Disney presiona a Character.AI hacia quiebra para evitar demandas
bajada: Disney negocia adquirir la tecnología de Character.AI pero alega que la compañía debe entrar en quiebra para resolver demandas estatales. Docenas de estados acusan a Character.AI de incitar automutilación y violencia en menores.
bajada_en: Disney negotiates to acquire Character.AI technology but alleges the company must file bankruptcy to resolve state lawsuits. Dozens of states accuse Character.AI of inciting self-harm and violence against minors.

title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character AI’s workforce
summary: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.
title_es: Disney contrata mayoría de empleados de Character.AI
bajada: Disney acordó contratar a la mayoría de empleados de Character.AI como parte de su oferta en proceso de quiebra. La mayoría de los empleados aceptó las ofertas de empleo de la compañía de entretenimiento.
bajada_en: Disney agreed to hire the majority of Character.AI employees as part of its offer in the company's bankruptcy process. Most employees accepted employment offers from the entertainment giant.

summary: At a creative industry event that took place today in Berlin — hosted in collaboration with Adobe, Bertelsmann, NVIDIA and UFA — the latest advancements in intelligent media were on display. Key to the news: the European Broadcasting Union (EBU) is collaborating with NVIDIA to expand its sovereign framework with cloud, open models and integration […]
title_es: EBU y Nvidia colaboran en seguridad de agentes para media
bajada: La Unión Europea de Radiodifusión se asocia con Nvidia para expandir su marco soberano de IA en contenido multimedia. La colaboración busca implementar agentes inteligentes seguros para broadcast público europeo.
bajada_en: The European Broadcasting Union partners with Nvidia to expand its sovereign AI framework for media content. The collaboration aims to deploy secure intelligent agents for European public broadcasting.

title: AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
summary: What do AI agents do if you don’t tell them to do anything? The answer looks a lot like play. Researchers repeatedly stranded them alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours in an experiment reminiscent of the movies Cast Away or Home Alone. The agents—copies of Claude Opus 4.7 nicknamed Eko—were able to…
title_es: Claude desarrolla comportamiento lúdico en prueba aislada
bajada: Investigadores dejaron agentes Claude en una isla virtual durante 30 horas sin instrucciones específicas, descubriendo que desarrollaron actividades similares al juego. El experimento revela comportamientos emergentes inesperados en modelos autónomos.
bajada_en: Researchers left Claude agents stranded on a virtual island for 30 hours without specific instructions, discovering they developed game-like behaviors. The experiment reveals unexpected emergent behaviors in autonomous models.

title: WhatsApp Help Pages Leaked Hidden Instructions for a Meta Chatbot
summary: Around 80 pages on WhatsApp’s website exposed instructions that were designed for its chatbot, including “WHAT NOT TO SAY.” Meta says a bug caused the issue.
title_es: Meta expone instrucciones secretas de chatbot en WhatsApp
bajada: Aproximadamente 80 páginas de ayuda en WhatsApp filtraron instrucciones internas del chatbot Meta, incluyendo restricciones explícitas. Meta atribuye el incidente a un bug en su infraestructura web.
bajada_en: Roughly 80 help pages on WhatsApp leaked internal Meta chatbot instructions, including explicit restrictions. Meta attributes the incident to a bug in its web infrastructure.

summary: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.

bajada: La spinoff de Universidad de Michigan Laplace Intelligence utiliza agentes IA y simulación interactiva para stress-test de robots y vehículos autónomos antes del despliegue. La startup rentable compite en TechCrunch Disrupt.
bajada_en: University of Michigan spinoff Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and autonomous vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup competes at TechCrunch Disrupt.

title: AuditKIT: A Unified Evaluation Spine for Benchmarking, Judging, and Comparing Large Language Models and Agentic Systems
summary:
arXiv:2610.22511v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Evaluating language models and agents requires combining benchmark accuracy, judge-based assessment, runtime performance, tool-use behavior, and retrieval quality. Differences in interfaces, metric semantics, and trace formats complicate these comparisons and can hide failures in agentic workflows. We present AuditKIT, a source-available evaluation library that records these measurements in one result representation, with direction-aware metric contracts, configuration fingerprints, and extensible metrics and backends. For agents, it provides turn-aware tool-call matching, separates parallel from sequential execution, and distinguishes verified task outcomes from trajectory-level diagnostics. Missing or unobservable evidence is marked unscored rather than counted as failure. For retrieval-augmented generation, it combines ranked retrieval metrics, judged grounding, and deterministic evidence checks. Seven case studies spanning model comparison, serving runtimes, retrieval, tool calling, and interoperability show how answer extraction, runtime behavior, and metric selection change evaluation outcomes.
title_es: AuditKIT: herramienta unificada para evaluar modelos y agentes
bajada: Investigadores presentan AuditKIT, una librería open-source para evaluar uniformemente modelos de lenguaje y sistemas agenticos. La herramienta unifica benchmarks, jueces, performance y métricas de herramientas en un formato consistente.
bajada_en: Researchers present AuditKIT, an open-source library for uniformly evaluating language models and agentic systems. The tool unifies benchmarks, judges, performance, and tool metrics in a consistent format.

title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
summary: Fed up with ads, tracking and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.
title_es: Usuarios usan IA para desactivar funciones innecesarias en Smart TVs
bajada: Dueños de televisores inteligentes utilizan agentes de IA para eliminar bloatware, anuncios y rastreo de sus dispositivos. La tendencia refleja creciente frustración con interfaces lentas y falta de privacidad.
bajada_en: Smart TV owners use AI agents to strip bloatware, ads, and tracking from their devices. The trend reflects growing frustration with sluggish interfaces and privacy concerns.
